title: Tool schema events serialize raw ToolSchema objects
reasoning: The base serialization method copies list and dict fields directly into the output without recursively converting their contents. SystemPromptEvent and ToolSchemasEvent carry List[ToolSchema], so to_dict can emit ToolSchema instances inside the returned dictionary instead of JSON-compatible dictionaries. Since this module describes events for WebSocket communication, that can fail at JSON encoding time or violate the frontend event contract for schema transparency payloads.
reproduction: Instantiate ToolSchemasEvent with a non-dict ToolSchema object and pass event.to_dict() to a JSON encoder; the returned tool_schemas list will still contain the original object unless ToolSchema itself is already a dict-like type.
recommendation: Teach StreamingEvent.to_dict to recursively normalize nested values, using model_dump/dict/dataclasses.asdict where applicable, or override to_dict on schema-bearing events to serialize each ToolSchema explicitly.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for this feature, and the excerpt contains no serialization coverage for schema-bearing streaming events.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a unit test that constructs SystemPromptEvent and ToolSchemasEvent with realistic ToolSchema instances, calls to_dict, and verifies the result is JSON-serializable and contains plain dictionaries for schemas.
minimumFixScope: Update streaming event serialization for nested schema objects and add focused tests for the schema-bearing event types.
